name: ATZ CRM
description: ATZ CRM is a comprehensive customer relationship management platform designed to streamline your sales and customer service processes. It offers tools for managing contacts, tracking sales, and enhancing customer interactions, making it ideal for businesses looking to improve their customer engagement and sales efficiency.

events.d: Creates a new candidate in ATZ CRM using the provided details and returns the created candidate record.
Update a candidate's profile with new details such as name, contact, position, salary, languages, tags, custom fields, or resume.
Create a new contact in ATZ CRM with details such as name, email, phone, organization, stage, owner, and tags.
Update a contact in ATZ CRM by providing the contact slug and any fields to change (name, email, phone, address, tags, owner, stage, description, etc.).
Create a new organization record in ATZ CRM with name, website, location, owner, tags, and other details.
Update an existing deal in ATZ CRM with new details such as name, close date, stage, amount, contacts, organization, owner, and tags.
Create a job opening with title, location, salary, headcount, tags, skills, contacts, collaborators, and an optional application form.
Update an organization's details (name, website, location, address, industry, owner, tags, and social links) using its slug.
Modify an existing job posting in ATZ CRM using the job slug. Update fields such as position, salary, dates, skills, status, collaborators, and other job details.
Add a new contact to ATZ CRM.
Create a candidate profile in ATZ CRM for tracking and follow-up.
Update a candidate's details in ATZ CRM.
Remove a candidate record from ATZ CRM.
Triggered when a contact is deleted from ATZ CRM.
Add a new contact or update an existing contact in ATZ CRM.
Add a new sales deal to ATZ CRM.
Remove a deal from ATZ CRM.
Triggers when an existing deal's details are updated in ATZ CRM.
Triggers when a new job is added in ATZ CRM and provides the new job's details for use in workflows.
Triggered when a job is deleted in ATZ CRM; returns details about the removed job.
Sends updated job information to ATZ CRM so the job record in the CRM stays current.
Notifies when a new organization is added to ATZ CRM and provides its details.
Notifies when an organization is removed from ATZ CRM and provides the deleted organization's details.
Update an organization's details in ATZ CRM, such as name, address, or contact information.
Create a folder for a candidate, contact, deal, job, or organization record.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a candidate is assigned to a job in the account.
Update a folder's name, description, or sharing settings.
Add a note to a candidate, job, organization, contact, or deal by providing its record slug and note text.
Add a record to a folder using its record type and slug.
Add an existing candidate to a job opening.
Create a call record with direction, start time, duration, notes, recording, and associate it with contacts, deals, jobs, or organizations.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a candidate is removed from a job in the account.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a candidate's talent stage is updated.

events.n: Job Application Received from External Source
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a job application is submitted from an external source.
Retrieve a list of users from ATZ CRM.
Retrieve contacts from ATZ CRM with optional sorting, pagination, and selected fields.
Remove a candidate from a job.
Retrieve candidates with optional sorting, pagination, and selected fields.
List jobs with optional sorting, pagination, and filters.
Change a talent's stage for a specific job.
Retrieve stages for a talent funnel using its funnel ID.

events.n: Enroll Contact or Candidate in Sequence
events.d: Add a contact or candidate to a sequence so they receive scheduled messages and automated follow-ups.
Unenroll a contact or candidate from a specified sequence.
Search sequences by keyword, entity type, date ranges, sort options, and pagination.
